as_told.title: E.T. based on a Kentucky farm family hiding an alien (Night Skies)

plain: A case from a Kentucky farm, where a family is said to have found an alien and hidden it in their barn, was the starting point for a film called Night Skies, which the director Steven Spielberg was developing as a producer. As the story is filed, that project is linked to his later alien film E.T. An unnamed guest tells this in the same words on two of Michels's episodes about Hollywood and UFOs, and doesn't say where he heard it.
